judgement.doubts: Every post-snapshot event is a bound; none is whole, and the record itself says the core question is unresolved, so 'claimed' was F1/F3. Status tier is progress; Klartag (human, digested by Kalai) is the named anchor, but by §4 step 4 the ai_role is the strongest among same-tier bounds on different quantities, so Astra's 'generated' is kept if Astra's result is counted as a genuine upper-bound exponent improvement. If a later reader follows F3 strictly (a bound on the LP method only, scope none), ai_role would fall to Huawei's 'assisted' (itself borderline: BO/MCTS search may be read as non-AI computation per F9).

outcome_prefix: Judged: the status rests on bound-level progress — Klartag's April 2025 n²·2^-n lattice lower bound, alongside AI-produced upper-bound work (Huawei/UCL, Astra) of the same tier; nothing settles the bullet.
